cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I told your mother I'm scared she dislikes me. Sunday, you owe me an equally embarrassing admission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to tell her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I trusted you to risk something too. What scares you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's equal. Now tell her over lunch. Mine had an audience; yours needs one too.
